scope: Single-object image-to-3D inputs; two humans have no backpacks and T pose

prompts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: single-object image-to-3D modeling reference.
Input image: supporting STYLE reference only. Use the clean suit design, scale, warm ivory/graphite materials and restrained orange accents of the female pilot on the LEFT. Create a new matching standalone backpack, not a crop of a person and not a character image.
Primary request: ONE compact life-support backpack for this pilot, shown alone in a readable front-side three-quarter product view so the body's thickness is clear. The shape is a simple rounded rectangular TWO-LAYER housing: one calm warm ivory outer shell over one graphite inner layer. The two layers form one physically connected object. Two concealed flush attachment interfaces on the rear face attach the pack directly to the suit; do not invent shoulder straps. One small single ventilation slit. One very thin restrained orange accent. Clean broad surfaces with only the necessary structural parting line.
The pack must have a compact, plausible wearable thickness and simple functional geometry, without making it a flat slab. Preserve the reference's quiet contemporary science-fiction design. No person, no mannequin, no hand, no loose mounting accessories, no straps, no hoses, no crane arms, no exposed cylinders, no antenna forest, no dozens of buttons, no glowing trim.
Background: plain very light neutral gray. Soft even product illumination and a faint grounded contact shadow. Entire single pack fully in frame, centered with margin. No diagram, no second view, no inset, no text, no logo, no watermark.

Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: single-object image-to-3D modeling reference.
Input image: supporting STYLE reference only. Match the clean modern suit, warm ivory ceramic-like shells, graphite inner structure and thin orange accents of the male engineer on the RIGHT. This is a NEW matching standalone backpack, not a crop or a human figure.
Primary request: ONE slightly wider life-support backpack module for the engineer. Its main body is a clean rounded rectangular box divided into TWO LARGE physically connected sections, with a restrained structural seam between them. Two broad calm ivory panels over a graphite core, a small unobtrusive ventilation opening and a thin orange accent. Rear attachment sockets sit flush against the wearer's suit rather than using straps. Show the complete pack alone in a clear front-side three-quarter product view, with its depth and wearable scale evident.
Use large functional surfaces and minimal detail consistent with the reference. Compact balanced proportions, slightly broader and more robust than a pilot pack, without decorative attachments. No crane arm, no manipulator, no tools attached outside, no hoses, no cables, no cylinders, no straps, no person, no hands, no second loose object.
Backdrop: plain very light neutral gray studio background, soft even studio light, faint contact shadow. One complete centered object only with margin, not multiple views or a collage. No text, no labels, no logos, no watermark.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: single-character image-to-3D modeling reference.
Input image: edit target. The supplied image contains two suited humans. Isolate ONLY the slimmer female pilot on the LEFT and preserve her exact suit design, helmet, body proportions, restrained materials and colors. Remove the male figure completely.
Primary request: show this one female pilot alone in a STRICT T-POSE, viewed exactly from the FRONT with an orthographic camera. Both upper arms and forearms form one straight horizontal line at shoulder height, extended 90 degrees from the torso; elbows straight, wrists neutral. Gloved fingers remain neutral and slightly separated, not clenched or splayed dramatically. Feet parallel at hip width. The entire helmet, both hands and every fingertip, both legs and boots must be fully visible with clear space around them.
Remove her backpack completely, including its shoulder silhouette and all backpack mounts projecting behind the torso. No handheld items, tools, weapons, holsters or extra equipment.
Keep the same warm ivory smooth chest and shoulder shells, fine pale fabric body suit, graphite flexible joints, restrained orange strip placement and dark closed rounded visor from the LEFT reference character. Preserve realistic anatomy and the reference's clean, modern, low-detail design. Do not redesign the suit or add new panel details.
Backdrop: plain very light neutral gray studio background, soft even front illumination, only a faint contact shadow under the boots. Premium clean product-render fidelity with legible material boundaries. One full-body character centered in a wide enough frame to contain the horizontal T-pose. No perspective angle, no three-quarter view, no side or back views, no inset, no turntable sheet, no text, no labels, no watermark.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: single-character image-to-3D modeling reference.
Input image: edit target. The supplied image contains two suited humans. Isolate ONLY the broader male engineer on the RIGHT and preserve his exact suit design, closed helmet, body proportions, restrained materials and colors. Remove the female figure completely.
Primary request: show this one male engineer alone in a STRICT T-POSE, viewed exactly from the FRONT with an orthographic camera. Both arms are fully straight and horizontal at shoulder height, 90 degrees from his torso, with neutral wrists. Every gloved finger is neutral and slightly separated. Feet parallel at hip width. Helmet, fingers and boots all fully inside the image, with clear surrounding margin. Anatomically plausible broad masculine proportions, without enlarging the armor.
Remove the backpack entirely, with no pack visible behind either shoulder or the waist. No tools, weapons, handheld objects, holsters or additional equipment.
Keep the RIGHT character's warm ivory smooth protective chest, shoulder and forearm shells, pale fabric suit, graphite flexible joints, exact restrained orange accents and dark closed visor. Preserve the original simple modern large-surface design. Do not add armor layers, technical clutter, new straps or tiny panels.
Backdrop: plain very light neutral gray studio background. Soft even front studio light with only a faint boot contact shadow. Clean realistic premium product render. One full-body character only, centered and framed wide enough for the T-pose. No perspective angle, no three-quarter view, no second view, no inset, no text, no labels, no watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Prepare this exact spacecraft as a single-object image-to-3D reference. Preserve the Manta spacecraft design, proportions, hull geometry, cockpit, materials, orange service patches and all three landing supports exactly. Keep the entire craft in the same three-quarter view with generous clear margin. Remove the tiny standing human completely. Exactly ONE spacecraft only, no person, no floor markings, no other object, no labels. Neutral plain light-gray seamless background with very soft contact shadow. Even studio fill so all hull surfaces and landing supports read clearly. Do not add new details or alter the design. Opaque background.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Prepare this alien Lacuna spacecraft as a clean single-object image-to-3D reference. Preserve its massive continuous open-C silhouette, two unequal thick arms, short rear linking spine, genuine empty central aperture, rich depth and original three-quarter camera. Exactly one alien craft. Remove the small human spacecraft and all planets/stars/space scenery. Use a plain light-gray seamless studio background with clear even fill lighting. Simplify the exterior into large calm matte dark graphite ceramic slabs with pale ivory inner structural surfaces; remove scratches, chips and micro-panel clutter. Keep only a small number of large clear field-lamella groups inside each arm and a few restrained amber interfaces. Maintain strong engineered form and controlled material texture, not a toy or featureless plastic. The center must stay EMPTY and all parts structurally connected; no floating rocks, strings, extra branches or bright portal. Entire craft visible with margin. No ground plane attached to the craft, no other objects, no text or diagrams. Opaque background.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: isolated single-object image-to-3D modeling reference.
Input image: edit target. It contains three devices. Isolate ONLY the LARGE C-SHAPED SCANNER on the LEFT, removing the wrist device and short multitool entirely.
Preserve this scanner's exact design: horizontal rounded rectangular ivory body with a graphite lower/side layer, large recessed dark display with a simple cyan measurement curve, large circular gray physical dial with a short orange arc, very thin orange lower seam, and the thick C-shaped open sensor jaws at the left. Keep the C opening genuinely empty and clearly readable. Keep the two small cyan sensor contact faces on the jaw tips. This is a measuring instrument, with no pistol grip, trigger, barrel, gun shape or added parts.
Reframe the same scanner as one complete object in a clean front-side three-quarter product view; preserve the reference angle as closely as possible while making the existing housing and jaws' real thickness clear. Do not flatten it into an icon, redesign its proportions, invent new controls or add extra texture.
Backdrop: plain very light neutral gray, soft even product lighting, faint contact shadow. Single complete object centered with clear margins; no other equipment, no hands, no inset, no extra view, no text, no label, no watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: isolated single-object image-to-3D modeling reference.
Input image: edit target. Isolate ONLY the WRIST DEVICE at the TOP RIGHT. Remove the large C-shaped scanner and short multitool completely.
Preserve the same compact ivory rounded rectangular display housing, dark screen and simple cyan measurement curve, restrained thin orange accent and graphite broad band. Show this one device alone in a clean three-quarter view with the display on TOP and the wrist strap forming ONE CLEARLY CLOSED OVAL RING under it. The ring must be a coherent continuous loop with visible inner space, real band width and thickness; not a disconnected ribbon, not a flat rectangular plate, not two loose strap pieces. Preserve the design and quiet materials; no additional controls, extra gadgets or decorative detail.
Backdrop: plain very light neutral gray studio background, soft even product illumination, faint contact shadow. One complete device fully visible and centered with margin. No wrist, hand, arm, person, second object, extra view, inset, text, labels or watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: isolated single-object image-to-3D modeling reference.
Input image: edit target. Isolate ONLY the SHORT MULTITOOL at the BOTTOM RIGHT. Remove the large C-shaped scanner and wrist device entirely.
Preserve the original compact oblong ivory housing, large dark graphite side grip panel and top inset, very thin orange parting line, dark front collar and the SHORT projecting metal hexagonal tool tip. Keep that tip short and mechanically credible, with no extension, blade, gun barrel or redesign. Preserve the reference's simple contemporary instrument proportions and materials; do not add buttons, screws, cables or new greeble.
Show one complete tool alone in a clean three-quarter product view matching the original angle, so the rounded body's depth and the short tip are both unambiguous. Entire object fully visible with clear margin.
Backdrop: plain very light neutral gray, soft even product lighting, faint contact shadow. Single object only. No hand, no other tool, no loose bit, no diagram, inset, extra view, text, label, logo or watermark.
